An earlier note described it as 'verified absent', which was wrong: it was absent from the saved locator set, not from the page.
_calibration_notes.success_toaster: REQUIRES_STATE_CHANGING_CALIBRATION — not present in the DOM (hidden or otherwise) at PDP load, after the CTA click, or at the login-sheet stage. Only the generic empty containers div.b2b_sentient_nudge and div.--sentient-top_ContextNudge match toaster-like markup, and neither is it. Calibrating it requires submitting a valid OTP and creating a real photo request. No guessed locator saved.
_calibration_notes.resend_otp_link: NOT CALIBRATED. At the OTP stage the control is a countdown ('A new OTP has been sent.' + 'Retry in 00:59'), not a link. The actionable resend control appears only after the countdown expires and was not observed. TC_AFP_C02 row 91 asserts it, so the flow cannot cover that step until a timed pass captures it.
